title: AIO2: Online Correction of Object Labels for Deep Learning With Incomplete Annotation in Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
mechanism: Adaptive correction trigger from the mean-teacher accuracy curve plus online object-wise label correction for missing objects.
adaptation: Add teacher-predicted crack components to labels only if p > 0.9, length >= 20 px and not inside scuff / edge_dark; targets missed cracks flagged by the audit and speck-level H36 labels.
min_experiment: Arm: house + AIO2 correction. Baseline: house. Metric: crack component recall >= 20 px and relP@2. Kill if relP@2 drops > 0.02 or recall gain < +0.02. About 8 GPU-h.
evidence: R: robust under varying building label omission on two footprint datasets; in NSegment+ comparison AIO2 gave +0.20 Vaihingen, +0.54 Cityscapes mIoU at 2x FLOPs.
prior_overlap: partial: MT pseudo-labelling was run as SSL; online object-wise completion of labelled cells was not.
